zoneSweep.title: Zone Sweep Status
zoneSweep.desc: Fire Marshals physically sweep their zone and mark it cleared via their dedicated mobile link. Status updates here in real-time.

legalTooltip1: Employers are legally required to establish and maintain emergency procedures under the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 and the Health & Safety at Work Act 1974. This includes documented evacuation plans, designated assembly points, and regular fire drills.
legalTooltip2: is essential to confirm all persons are safe following an evacuation. Failure to account for all persons on site can have serious legal and safety consequences. Records of all drills and evacuations should be retained.
statusOptionsDesc: When enabled, Fire Marshals see a dropdown button next to each person's SAFE button on their muster screen. They can use it to mark someone as accounted for with a status reason (e.g. "Working remotely / offsite"). The person will appear with an amber badge in the muster list and incident report.
enableStatusOptionsDesc: Shows a dropdown chevron next to the SAFE button on the Fire Marshal muster screen
statusOptionsInputDesc: These options appear in the dropdown when a Fire Marshal marks someone with a reason.

accountability.tapShowSafe: Tap Show Safe above to view the full list.
accountability.tryClearing: Try clearing the search or adjusting your filter.

endEvacDialog.title: End Evacuation?
endEvacDialog.message: Ending the evacuation will mark it as complete and automatically save an incident report. Choose what to do with on-site personnel:

settingsPanel.title: Muster Status Options
settingsPanel.desc: When enabled, Fire Marshals will see a dropdown button next to each person's SAFE button on the muster screen. They can use it to mark someone as accounted for with an additional status reason (e.g. "Working remotely / offsite"). The person will appear as amber in the muster list and incident report.
settingsPanel.dropdownDesc: Shows a dropdown chevron next to the SAFE button on the Fire Marshal muster screen
settingsPanel.optionsDesc: These options appear in the dropdown when a Fire Marshal marks someone as accounted for with a reason.
